headline: Sensex and Nifty end lower as surging oil prices and hawkish RBI minutes erase early gains from IT stocks

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Surging crude oil prices pressured the market and weighed on investor sentiment
RBI MPC minutes indicated a potential rate-hike cycle as inflation heads toward the 6% ceiling
Banking stocks acted as a major drag, causing the indices to slump from their intraday highs
Subdued festive demand led to a 22% drop in passenger vehicle registrations according to FADA
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty closed lower, marking the second consecutive session of declines
The market witnessed a sharp reversal, slumping over 900 points from its intraday high
Jio Platforms IPO saw strong investor interest, being subscribed 3.01 times on its opening day
The Indian Rupee rose 46 paise to 94.45 against the US dollar on hopes of an India-US trade deal
summary: Indian markets closed lower for a second session as early gains were wiped out by surging crude oil prices and hawkish RBI minutes. A sell-off in banking stocks contributed to the Sensex slumping 900 points from its high, despite initial support from IT stocks. Key highlights included the strong debut of the Jio Platforms IPO and Zydus Lifesciences receiving US FDA approval for a generic therapy.
